newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian businessman files lawsuit over Busang.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian businessman files lawsuit over Busang.

text.p: A local businessman said Wednesday that he had filed a C$2 billion lawsuit ($1.48 billion) in Canada against Bre-X Minerals Ltd. over ownership of one of this century's greatest gold discoveries.
"Yes, I can confirm that I filed the suit yesterday and it is for C$2 billion," Jusuf Merukh told Reuters.
He said he took the legal action to reinforce his claim to the Busang gold deposit in northern Borneo, which contains at least 57 million ounces of gold, and perhaps 100 million ounces.
Calgary-based Bre-X discovered the huge deposit but the Indonesian government told it late last year to form a joint venture with rival Barrick Gold Corp. to develop the find.
"So far there's been no response from Bre-X," he said. "But if Bre-X agrees to my claim, I will withdraw my suit. They have to come to the negotiating table."
